The EIA 2024 plant table, which I read from the saved file, lists Riverton at 7240 SE Highway 66 with point 37.072616, -94.698704. That point is about 155 meters from GEM's and also falls inside the same plant grounds, near the northern switchyard. Both points are on the plant, so exact holds. The picture date is unknown.
